title: Who must not be contacted
lead: Aveline sends nothing to these addresses, from any of your organization’s events. Some come from guests: an unsubscribe, a bounce, a complaint, or erasing their data. Only the organization’s owner or a manager can see or change this list.

list.title: On the list
list.truncated: Only the newest 500 are shown: there may be more.

entry.global: Applies across Aveline after a bounce or a complaint, so it can’t be lifted here.
entry.erased: This person asked for their data to be erased, so they can’t be contacted again.

add.title: Add someone
add.phoneHelp: Type the number exactly as it is on the guest list, spaces included: a number written differently isn’t recognised.
add.already: {{address}} is already on the list for this, so nothing was changed.

errors.email: That doesn’t look like an email address.
errors.phone: That doesn’t look like a phone number.

lift.title: Allow messages to {{address}} again?
lift.body: Your events’ messages can reach this address again, reminders included.

refused.noOrganization: This list belongs to an organization, and your account is on an event only. The organization’s owner can see and change it.
refused.forbidden: Only the organization’s owner or a manager can see or change this list.
refused.global: This address is held across Aveline after a bounce or a complaint, and can’t be lifted here. The list has been reloaded.
refused.erased: This person asked for their data to be erased; they can’t be contacted again. The list has been reloaded.
refused.gone: That entry is no longer on the list. The list has been reloaded.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. Check the list, then try again.
refused.chooseOrganization: Your account is in more than one organization, and this page can’t choose between them yet.
